product.title: Beginner Beginner BJJ by Craig Funk
product.body_html:
Jumpstart Your Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Journey With Craig Funk’s Step-By-Step Program To Prepare You For Your FIRST BJJ Class!

  • Black belt Craig Funk will help you learn what to expect in your first class, the best ways to learn, how to tie your belt, and much more!
  • Shorten your BJJ learning curve with a variety of solo and partner drills that will help you master the fundamental movements of Jiu-Jitsu.
  • Develop the ability to train safely with others and build healthy habits that lead to longevity in your BJJ training.
  • Craig peels back the curtain on some of the overlooked aspects of BJJ including learning how to tap, setting goals, and even how to pick the right school!


 

Check out a free sample:
